questions.title: How long a paused repository stays paused
questions.question: QA-108 (Choose how long a paused repository stays paused) can end a pause by itself. Should a paused repository resume after a day, or stay paused until you resume it?
questions.why: A pause today lasts until someone resumes it. Two repositories stayed paused for a week last month because nobody remembered them.
questions.if_unanswered: QA-108 waits in Code Review and no pause ends by itself.
questions.recommendation_reason: A pause that ends by itself can start work you meant to stop.

options.label: Stay paused until resumed
options.effect: QA-108 adds a reminder after a day; the pause stays until you resume it.

tradeoffs.text: You still resume each repository yourself.

options.label: Resume after a day
options.effect: QA-108 ends each repository pause one day after it started.

tradeoffs.text: Work can start while you are away.
